**The problem or pain** (what are you trying to do, and what makes it hurt today?)

**The proposal** (what should StateRoot do?)

**Alternatives you considered** (other tools, workarounds, doing nothing)

**Which harnesses does it touch?** (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Kimi Code / OpenClaw / Hermes / Pi / DSH / all)

**Continuity angle** (optional): does this affect shared state, memory, sessions, persona, plans, or delegation across harnesses? Say how, if you know.
